I am writing to apply for the Social Media Marketing Internship at MUTANI. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, SEO, and analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a brand that merges gaming culture with contemporary fashion.

In my current role at Episto, I create engaging content and manage WordPress sites, while my project mirook.com has allowed me to develop and execute social media strategies, including content planning and community engagement. I am proficient in tools like Canva, Google Analytics, and SEMrush, and I am eager to apply my skills to create scroll-stopping content and analyze performance to drive growth.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and can work from your office part-time. I am passionate about gaming and fashion, and I am excited about the chance to bring my creativity and analytical mindset to MUTANI.

Please find attached my resume and portfolio. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear MUTANI team,

I am thrilled to apply for the Social Media Marketing Internship at MUTANI. As a junior digital marketer with a passion for gaming and fashion, I have been following MUTANI's innovative approach to translating digital worlds into everyday wear, and I am eager to contribute to your community-driven growth.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in content creation, SEO, and analytics. I write keyword-targeted blog content, manage WordPress sites, and track performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. This experience has taught me to create content that not only looks good but also performs well, aligning perfectly with your focus on scroll-stopping content and data-driven optimization.

My personal project, mirook.com, allowed me to take full ownership of a website's digital presence. I designed and built the site, implemented social media integration, and developed a content strategy that increased engagement. I also conducted technical SEO and GEO audits, improving visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has made me comfortable with the entire content lifecycle, from ideation to analysis.

I am particularly drawn to MUTANI's mission to create premium apparel inspired by gaming culture. As a gamer myself, I understand the community and its aesthetics, and I am excited about the opportunity to create content that resonates with this audience. I am proficient in photo and video editing, graphic design with Canva, and comfortable filming with a smartphone. I am also eager to dive into analytics to understand what makes content perform and to experiment with paid social campaigns.

Based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, I can easily work from your office part-time. I am independent, organized, and always eager to learn. I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm make me a great fit for this internship.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to MUTANI's growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
